# History rewrite, 21 October 2026

The history was slimmed before its first push to GitHub, from about 2.1 GB to
about 0.2 GB. Every commit is kept, with its message, author, dates and parents.
The current tree is unchanged. Only generated outputs under artifacts/ were
removed from past commits:
- paths under artifacts/ that are no longer in the tree (the milestone-0 to
  milestone-9 outputs removed in the M10 cleanup) are absent from every commit;
- for paths still in the tree, a past version larger than 100 kB that is not the
  current version is absent from the commits that held it (the path shows as
  deleted there, never as another version).

Commit IDs changed. Commit messages were rewritten to the new IDs; the Markdown
docs were updated in the commit that adds this file. Other records (JSON
outputs) still cite the old IDs: look them up below.

The full original history is kept outside the repository, as a git bundle
(bipe-full-history-2026-10-21.bundle, made with `git bundle create --all` and
verified by a mirror clone and `git fsck --full` before the rewrite). It also
holds a Codex checkpoint ref that was dropped from the repository.
